content: Hessafe guye, Yesuusi Xoossaa kawotethaa Wongela sabbakishe katamaaranne gutaara aadhis. He wode tammanne nam7u hawaareti iyara de7oosona.
Qassi tuna ayyaanapenne dumma dumma hargiyafe paxida issi issi maccasati iyara de7oosona. Entika, laapun tuna ayyaanati keyida Magdela Mayraamo,
Herodiisa shuuma Kuuza machiw Yohaana, Soosinaranne qassi hara daroti entana miishen maaddeysati de7oosona.
Zerethi Zeriya Ura Leemiso
Daro asay dumma dumma katamaape iyako shiiqin leemison entaw odis.
“Issi goshshanchoy zerethi zeranaw keyis. I zerishin issi issi zerethay oge gaxan wodhidi yedhetis, salo kafoti maxidosona.
Harati shaalloy garsan de7iya biitta bolla wodhidosona. Buroo dolida mela biittan laahoy bayna gisho miccidosona.
Hara zerethay qassi aguntha giddon wodhis. Agunthaara wolla diccida gisho agunthay cuullidi bessan ashshis.
Harati lo77o biitta bolla wodhidosona. Dolida wode xeetu kushe ayfidosona.” Hessa odi ongidi, ba qaala dhoqu oothidi, “Si7iya haythi de7iya ubbay si7o” yaagis.
Iya tamaareti, “Ha leemisuwa birshethay aybee?” yaagidi oychidosona
I, “Xoossaa kawotethaa xuuraa erana mela hintew imetis. Shin harati be7ishe demmonna mela, si7ishe akeekona mela leemison odayis.
“Hiza, ha leemisuwa birshethay haysa: koche yaagetiday Xoossaa qaala.
Oge gaxan wodhida zerethay qaala si7eyisata. Gidoshin, enti ammanidi attonna mela Xalahey qaala enta wozanaape maxi diggees.
Shaalloy garsan de7iya biitta bolla wodhida zerethay qaala si7idi ufaysan ekeyisata. Enti ha77is ammanoosonape attishin, xaphoy bayna gisho paacey gakiya wode ellesidi kaddoosona.
Aguntha giddon zeretida zerethay qaala si7eyisata. Entika alamiya qofan, duretethaninne sa7a duussaa miikotethan cuuletidi besseysada ayfibookona.
Lo77o biittan wodhida zerethay lo77o wozanan qaala si7idi naageysatanne danda7an minnidi ayfe ayfeyisata.
“Xompe oythidi, daacho kammey woyko arsafe garsan wothey deenna. Geliya asi be7ana mela dhoqa bessan wothees.
“Hessa gisho, qonce keyonna qosetidi attiyabay, eretonna geemmidi attiyabay deenna.
“Hiza, hinte qaala waati si7iyako akeekite. De7iya ubbaas guzhetidi imetana, baynaysas hari attoshin iyaw de7iya guuthiyaka iyape eketana” yaagis.
Yesuusa Aayeranne Ishatara
Yesuusa aayeranne ishatara iyako yidosona. Shin asaa darotethaafe dendoysan iya demmanaw danda7ibookona.
Issi asi Yesuusako, “Ne aayeranne ne ishatara nena koyidi karen naagoosona” yaagis.
Yesuusi zaaridi, “Xoossa qaala si7idi ooson peesheysati ubbay, taw aayonne taw isha” yaagis.
Yesuusi Hobbiya Seeris
Issi gallas Yesuusaranne iya tamaaretara issife wogolon gelidi, “Abbaa pinnoos” yaagis. Entika baanaw dendidosona.
Abbaa bollara enti pinnanaw bishin Yesuusi dhiskis. Qoponna mino carkoy abba bolla dendis. Haathi wogoluwan gelin wogoloy mitetethi oykiya wode ubbay babidosona.
Iya tamaareti iyako shiiqidi, “Godaw! Godaw! nu dhayos” yaagidi Yesuusa denthidosona. Yesuusi dendidi carkuwanne gotiya hanqis. Ellesidi carkoynne gotey wopu gis; sarotethi simmis.
Yesuusi ba tamaaretako, “Hinte ammanoy awunee?” yaagis. Entika, yayyishenne malaaletishe issoy issuwako, “Carkoynne haathay kiiteteysi, I haysi oonee” yaagidosona.
Tuna Ayyaani Iyape Keyda Ura
Abba pinnidi Galila baggara de7iya Gergesoone biitta gakidosona.
Yesuusi wogolope keyidi sa7an wodhishin tuna ayyaanan oyketida uray katamaape keydi iyara gahetis. Daro laythi ma7o ma7onna kallo duufon de7eesipe attishin, soo gelenna.
Yesuusa be7ida wode iya sinthan gufannidi, ba qaala dhoqu oothidi, “Ubbaafe Bolla Xoossaa na7aw Yesuusa neera taw aybi issifetethi de7ii? Hayyana tana ha77i un7ethofarki” yaagis.

Hessa I giday, tuna ayyaanay uraape keyana mela Yesuusi hanqida gishosa. Daro wode tuna ayyaanay iya haarida gisho santhalaataninne toho qachiya biratan qashetidi naagetees. Shin qashuwa duuthidi tuna ayyaanan laagetidi mela biitta gelis.
Yesuusi, “Ne sunthay oone” yaagidi oychis. I, daro tuna ayyaanati iya oykida gisho bana, “Leegiyona” gis.
Tuna ayyaanati bantana Si7oole kiittonna mela woossidosona.
He bessan zooze bolla miya guduntho wudey hemetees. Hini gudunthotan gelino gidi woossidosona, ika “Gelite” gis.
Tuna ayyaanati uraape keyidi gudunthotan gelidosona. Wudey deriyape duge gurguxidi abban gelis.
Henthanchoti hanidaysa be7ida wode woxi bidi, katamaninne guta ubban odidosona.
Asay hanidaba be7anaw keyidi Yesuusako yidosona. Tuna ayyaanay keyida uray ma7o ma7idi, iya wozanay simmin, Yesuusa toho matan uttidaysa demmidi yayyidosona.
Iya be7ida asay tuna ayyaanan oyketida uray waanidi paxidaako odidosona.
Gergesoone yuushon de7iya asay gita yashshi yayidi, Yesuusi banta matape baana mela woossidosona. I wogoluwan gelidi guye simmis.
Tuna ayyaanay keyida uray Yesuusara daanaw woossis.
Shin Yesuusi iyako, “Ne soo simma, Xoossay ay mela gitaba new oothidaako oda” yaagidi moyzis. Urayka Yesuusi ay mela gitaba iyaw oothidaako katama ubban markatishe bis.
Hayqida Na7iwunne Hargetiya Maccasiw
Asay naagidi gam7ida gisho Yesuusi simmiya wode moki ekidosona.
Ayhude woosa keetha halaqa gidida Iyaroosa geetetiya uray ba soo yaana mela Yesuusa tohuwa bolla wodhidi woossis.
Iyaw tammanne nam7u laythi gidida macca na7i saketada hayqos gakada de7awusu. Yesuusi biya wode asay iya un7ethees.
Tammanne nam7u laythi suuthi goggishe gam7ida maccasi de7awusu. Iya baw de7iya miishiya aakimetas immada ongasu. Shin paxanaw danda7abuku.
Iya Yesuusas guye baggara shiiqada, iya afilaa macaraa bochasu, iiraka goggiya suuthay eqi aggis.
Yesuusi, “Tana bochiday oonee?” yaagis. Ubbay, “Nu bochibooko” yaagin, Phexroosi, “Astamaariyaw, daro asay kaallishininne un7ethishin be7ashe waanada, ‘Tana bochiday oonee?’ gay” yaagis.
Shin Yesuusi, “Issi asi tana bochis; ayis giiko, wolqi taape keyoysi taw eretis” yaagis.
Maccasiya, ibay qoncidaysa erida wode kokorashe yada Yesuusa tohuwa bolla kundasu. Ayis bochidaakonne waanada ellesada paxidaako asaa ubbaa sinthan markatasu.
I, “Ta naate, ne ammanoy nena pathis; saro ba” yaagis.
Yesuusi oda ongonna de7ishin, ayhude woosa keetha halaqaa, Iyaroosa soope issi asi yidi, “Iyaroosa, ne na7iya hayqasu; astamaariya mela daabursofa” yaagis.
Shin Yesuusi hessa si7idi Iyaroosako, “Babofa! Ammana, ne na7iya paxana” yaagis.
Yesuusi Iyaroosa soo gakida wode Phexroosape, Yohaanisape, Yayqoobape, na7e aawapenne aayepe attishin, hari gelana mela koybeenna.
He bessan de7iya asa ubbay na7ees mishetidi yeekishin, Yesuusi, “Yeekofite Na7iya dhiskasupe attishin, hayqabuuku” yaagis.
Asay na7iya hayqidaysa eriya gisho, iya oda leqidi miicidosona.
Shin Yesuusi na7e kushiya oykidi, “Naatte denda” yaagis.
Na7ees shempoy simmin denda eqasu. Yesuusi entako, “Iwu miyaba immite” yaagis.
Na7ee aawaranne aayera malaaletidosona. Shin Yesuusi haysa, “Oodeska odopite” yaagis.
